narr.Aqua Roma: W43 users 6,020, up 14.2 per cent on the week and 2.2 per cent above last year, the first week this year the venue has been ahead of its 2025 line. GA4 bookings 226 against 128, and against 296 last year, so the gap to 2025 has narrowed from 62 to 24 per cent. Conversion rate 3.8 per cent against 2.4 last week and 5.0 last year. This is the first clean full week of booking tracking since the October break, so the step up is partly recovery of measurement and partly real: SevenRooms website covers at Aqua NYC also rose, 366 to 495. The ad panels are the shared Aqua NYC account and carry a Halloween landing-page-view campaign that spent 1,158 dollars for no booking conversions, which is why Meta CPA worsens to 43.50 dollars while Google CPA improves to 35.90.
narr.Aqua Kyoto: W43 users 749 with 13 GA4 bookings, against 12 the week before; conversion rate 1.7 per cent. The room runs at about an eighth of Aqua Roma's traffic. It is still published as a 2026 launch with no year-on-year line, following the standing position, but the 2025 matched week does carry real data on its pages: 108 create-path booking events and, on the covers side, bookings at Aqua Kyoto NYC in SevenRooms throughout the 2025 week. While that position stands, Aqua Roma's continuation line carries Kyoto's 2025. The ad panels are the shared Aqua NYC account.
narr.Hutong NYC: W43 users 5,650, up 1.4 per cent on the week and 37.1 per cent above last year, the strongest user line of the four. GA4 bookings 148 against 90, and 239 last year, a year-on-year fall of 38 per cent on a conversion rate of 2.6 per cent against 5.8. The venue is buying far more traffic and converting it at less than half last year's rate, which is the clearest single signal on this page. Google spend nearly doubled to 2,150 dollars and its CPA worsened to 66.60, driven by a new Search > Midtown campaign at 998 dollars for 3 booking conversions; Search > Brand returned 16 for 290. Meta moved the other way, 51.90 dollars a schedule against 100.70. Walk-in signals continue to fall year on year, 333 against 873, which is consistent with the March 2026 move of the Google Business Profile booking provider to OpenTable rather than with lost demand.
narr.Hutong Miami: W43 users 4,358, up 13.6 per cent on the week and 30.3 per cent above last year. GA4 bookings 55 against 31, and 135 last year, with conversion rate 1.3 per cent against 4.0. Like Hutong NYC it is paying for more traffic and converting far less of it. Two cautions on this venue. Its booking event fired on all seven days but create-path bookings run at only 0.98 times SevenRooms website booking rows, about 1.04 settled-equivalent, against a pre-break norm of 1.22 to 1.29, so some under-recording cannot be ruled out for a second week. Against that, Meta is the week's clearest improvement anywhere in the market: 52 schedules on flat spend, 31.40 dollars each against 75.10. Google remains inefficient at 72.90 dollars a booking.

Aqua Roma: Users 2.2 per cent above last year while conversion rate falls 5.0 to 3.8 per cent
Aqua Kyoto: Published as a 2026 launch with no year-on-year line, though the 2025 matched week carries data
Hutong NYC: Users 37.1 per cent above last year while conversion rate falls 5.8 to 2.6 per cent
Hutong Miami: Users 30.3 per cent above last year while conversion rate falls 4.0 to 1.3 per cent
